title: Indoor bike: aerobic load, zero impact
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 4x6min at 152-162 bpm, 3min easy spin between. Seated throughout, cadence 85-90 in the efforts, 90+ in the warmup. Do not stand: standing loads the band through the flexion range.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 1 Isocarb C2:1 Pro bottle, 500ml, sipped across the hour. Treat it as bottle practice, not calorie need.
STOP RULE: the bike should be silent on the knee. Any lateral pain here is a different and worse signal than pain running, and it stops the session.
WHY: 60 load with no eccentric cost and no ground impact, 9 days out, 48h before Presolana. This is the cheapest CTL on the board and a better pre-rehearsal day than a treadmill quality block.
